Before your shift

Getting started

This handbook covers billing a patient for their medicines and lab tests, reviewing past bills, and keeping the medicine inventory up to date. Every screenshot is the real system.

  1. 1Open the hospital system in your browser and go to the address given to you by the Admin team.
  2. 2Type the Username and Password your Admin created for you.
  3. 3Click Login. You land on the Medical Counter dashboard automatically.
🔒Forgot your password? Only an Admin can reset it — ask them directly.
👁 What you'll see — the login screen

Status colours at a glance

The Bill column tells you who still needs to pay.

pending — still needs to be billed and paid
paid — done, receipt already issued
1

Active patients

Your home screen — every patient who has finished seeing the doctor today.

  1. 1Use Search to find a patient by name, Institute ID, or age.
  2. 2Check the Bill column — pending means they still owe money.
  3. 3Click anywhere on their row to open the billing screen.
A patient with an unpaid bill, ready to be billed
2

Bill a patient

Click a patient's row to open the billing screen.

  1. 1Under Select Billable Items, tick or untick each medicine and lab test — everything is ticked by default.
  2. 2Check the medicine Qty against what you're actually dispensing.
  3. 3Choose the Payment Mode (UPI, Cash, Card, or Salary for staff/faculty).
  4. 4Check the live Invoice Receipt Preview on the right before confirming.
  5. 5Click Confirm Payment & Mark as Paid.
Medicine and lab charges are billed as two separate receipts
Once paid, click Print & Email Receipt to hand over or send the receipt
⚠You can't undo Confirm Payment & Mark as Paid from this screen — double-check the items and quantities first.
3

Bill history

Bill History in the left menu — every invoice ever issued.

  1. 1Search by patient, or filter by date range.
  2. 2Total Revenue in the top-right updates to match your current filter.
  3. 3Click View/Print/Email on any row to reprint or resend that receipt.
Every invoice, reprintable at any time
4

Inventory

Inventory in the left menu — current medicine stock.

  1. 1Search by medicine ID, name, or manufacturer.
  2. 2Check Quantity and Expiry Date before dispensing.
Stock on hand, at a glance
5

Add medicine

Add Medicine in the left menu — register a new item into stock.

  1. 1The essentials: Item Name, Unit, Sale Rate, Quantity, Manufacturer, Batch Number and Expiry Date.
  2. 2Everything else on the form (HSN, GST Rate, Cess, Schedule, etc.) is accounting detail — leave it blank if you're unsure, or check with your Admin.
  3. 3Click Add Medicine at the bottom to save it.
A long form — only the essentials really matter day to day

Getting help

If a screen looks different from this guide, or an action doesn't behave as described, stop and contact your Admin or IT support before continuing. This guide was captured directly from the system on 8 September 2026 using a training patient record; nothing here is a real patient's data.
